abstract: Monitors permafrost disturbance approvals and wildlife deterrence operations
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENV). The Environmental compliance officer (ENV) oversees regulatory approvals concerning permafrost disturbance and tracks the status and responsiveness of wildlife encounter deterrence systems across proposed staging operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors permafrost disturbance approvals and wildlife deterrence operations（PERM）
information_points.content:
ENV-PERM-CO3：For the Low-impact modular overland transit staging plan, permafrost disturbance clearance is approved for the field staging and drilling corridor, the active wildlife encounter deterrence protocol is operational along the camp perimeter, and the maximum deterrent deployment time evaluated during safety drills is 15 min.
ENV-PERM-FUL：For the Amphibious tracked convoy staging plan, permafrost disturbance clearance is confirmed for the field staging and drilling corridor, the active wildlife encounter deterrence protocol is fully active, and the maximum deterrent deployment time observed during testing is 15 min.
ENV-PERM-FIV：For the Direct heavy-lift rotary airbridge staging plan, permafrost disturbance clearance is granted for the field staging and drilling corridor, the active wildlife encounter deterrence protocol is operational across the perimeter safety system, and the maximum deterrent deployment time recorded during drill evaluations is 25 min.

information_points.title: Soil organic carbon baseline（SOIL）
information_points.content:
ENV-SOIL-NMI：Under the Amphibious tracked convoy staging plan, the measured mean soil carbon density across the top 1 m of the active layer at the designated drill pad perimeter is 12.4 kg/m2.
ENV-SOIL-8GC：Under the Low-impact modular overland transit staging plan, the mean soil carbon density measured within the top 1 m of the active layer across the designated drill pad perimeter is 24.5 kg/m2.
ENV-SOIL-OI9：Under the Direct heavy-lift rotary airbridge staging plan, baseline measurements indicate a mean soil carbon density of 18.2 kg/m2 within the top 1 m of the active layer at the designated drill pad perimeter.
